```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .bnp-outer {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 1em 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .bnp-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: #5654A2;
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }

  .bnp-header-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(248, 247, 240, 0.2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .bnp-header-icon svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .bnp-header-text {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .bnp-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  }

  .bnp-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 18px 14px;
    text-align: center;
    background: #FBFAF6;
    border: 1px solid #E5E4DC;
    border-radius: 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    /* Pre-promote so the :active press has its layer up front. */
    will-change: transform;
    transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease,
                box-shadow 0.15s ease, transform 0.08s ease;
  }

  /* Hover: brighten the surface, lift the border, and add a soft lavender
     glow — no translate, matching the site-wide card language. */
  .bnp-card:hover {
    background: #F0EFF8;
    border-color: #C4C3E8;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(86, 84, 162, 0.16);
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .bnp-card:hover .bnp-card-icon {
    background: #F8F7F0;
  }

  /* Press: momentary scale-down, the site's click affordance. */
  .bnp-card:active {
    transform: scale(0.98);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(86, 84, 162, 0.14);
  }

  .bnp-card:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid #5654A2;
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  .bnp-card-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .bnp-card-icon svg {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    color: #5654A2;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .bnp-label {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #5654A2;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .bnp-foot {
    padding: 11px 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.8em;
    color: #6c757d;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .bnp-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>

<div class="bnp-outer">
  <div class="bnp-header">
    <div class="bnp-header-icon"><i data-lucide="image"></i></div>
    <span class="bnp-header-text">Explore My Site</span>
  </div>
  <div class="bnp-grid">
    <a class="bnp-card" href="/blog.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <div class="bnp-card-icon"><i data-lucide="newspaper"></i></div>
      <div class="bnp-label">Blog Posts</div>
    </a>
    <a class="bnp-card" href="/research.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <div class="bnp-card-icon"><i data-lucide="briefcase"></i></div>
      <div class="bnp-label">Research</div>
    </a>
    <a class="bnp-card" href="/cocktails.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <div class="bnp-card-icon"><i data-lucide="martini"></i></div>
      <div class="bnp-label">Cocktails</div>
    </a>
  </div>
  <div class="bnp-foot">The banners and images of these pages are generated by the <code>/ph-image</code> skill.</div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();
</script>
```
